title: perf(hooks): serve role hooks via one resident http daemon, and gate each with an if pattern
description:
## .what

run the claude code hooks that roles install through one always-on local server (claude code native `type: "http"` hooks), instead of a fresh process chain per hook per tool call.

## .why

- claude code supports http hooks natively (hooks reference: "HTTP hook fields"). a hook can POST to a local url instead of run a command
- measured upstream in anthropics/claude-code#39391: **34.6ms per command hook vs 0.31ms per http call** to a long-lived local server; **3,986ms vs 23ms** across a 120-call session
- measured on a dev box with ~10 live claude sessions: each tool call fires ~4 hook chains, each `sh -> rhx -> bun -> bash`. the box sustained 600-1300 forks/sec with cpu ~75% idle; the hook chains are a top share of the `sh` / `bash` / `MainThread` births

## .two levers

1. **available today, small:** the hook config accepts an `if` permission-rule pattern (e.g. `"Bash(git *)"`, `"Edit(*.ts)"`), evaluated on PreToolUse / PostToolUse / PostToolUseFailure / PermissionRequest / PermissionDenied. the hook command runs ONLY when the call matches. a guard that only matters for writes or edits should declare `if`, and stop to run on every call
2. **structural:** one resident hook daemon per seat (keyrackd is a precedent for a resident daemon) that serves every role hook over http. roles register handlers with it instead of a per-call command

## .scope

the hooks are installed by the upstream role packages (ehmpathy mechanic, bhrain driver + learner, bhuild behaver) via `rhachet init --hooks`. so the fix spans the hook registration contract, not one repo's `settings.json`

## .acceptance

- an audit: every installed hook, its event, its matcher, and whether it declares `if`
- every hook that cannot affect a given tool declares `if`, so it never runs there
- a measured before/after: hook process births per tool call, and wall time per tool call

## .sources

- https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/39391
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
